answer: The protocol validates 1,000 unique location proofs by measuring signal delay across a willow grove of sensors. An issuer assigns spatial coordinates, and each signed receipt proves the agent completed a voyage to that site as a verified node. A verifier reproduces failures by re-running logs; any latency discrepancy triggers a velvet penalty. Honest nodes pay linear travel costs, while 1,000 fakes incur unsustainable physical signal congestion.
